summary: Stone-tower lookout in Lassen Volcanic NP, built 1931 (1930 construction reported); NRHP-listed 2017; restored 2019-20; lost in the 2021 Dixie Fire.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two Forest Fire Lookout Association California-Northern reports (2019 and 2020) label the lookout as at Lava Beds National Monument. The register and Wikipedia place it in Lassen Volcanic National Park, which this story follows.

notes_for_editor: Build year is disputed: the register and Wikipedia say 1931; 1930 items quoted on Forest Lookouts describe construction and a station that year. Not settled. The 2019 and 2020 FFLA reports list the lookout as 'Harkness LO (Lava Beds Nat. Mon.) #516', which conflicts with the register's Lassen location. The Dixie Fire loss rests on the register and Wikipedia; Wikipedia cites a Redding Record Searchlight article (Chapman, 2021) that we did not locate. No source describes the site after the fire, so what remains and whether the site is open are unknown. The Forest Lookouts page was read in full during the 2026-10-09 verification pass; its Sept 10, 1930 completion item is now in the story and the events list. The NRHP nomination (NPGallery 100001211) was not read. Wikipedia's staffing line is undated. No WebSearch was available in this run.
